claims.claim: sdk.NewA2AAgent(url).WithAuth(scheme, token) and sdk.WithA2AAgent(agent) option on sdk.Open
The SDK calls /.well-known/agent-card.json to discover skills and registers each skill as a tool; done at Open (startup)
Builder methods WithAuth, WithAuthFromEnv, WithHeader, WithHeaderFromEnv, WithTimeout(ms), WithRetryPolicy(max, initialMs, maxMs), WithSkillFilter
WithHeaderFromEnv uses "Header-Name=ENV_VAR_NAME"; unset env var skips the header
WithAuthFromEnv reads token at startup; unset var connects without auth
tools.A2ASkillFilter{Allowlist, Blocklist}; allowlist takes precedence when both set
Multiple WithA2AAgent options register multiple agents
Tool name is a2a__{agentName}__{skillId}; sanitized: lowercased, non-alphanumeric runs replaced by underscores; table examples
Reference tool names in allowed_tools (spec.allowed_tools YAML) to control LLM access
Builder pattern handles auth, headers, retries and skill filtering automatically
Complete example compiles and uses WithTimeout(5000), WithRetryPolicy(3,100,2000)
